steps.title: Transform GST‑Mlph‑ABD plasmid
steps.instruction: Introduce GST‑Mlph‑ABD/pGEX4T2 into BL21(DE3) cells and recover on selective agar.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 ng (1 µL) plasmid into 100 µL BL21(DE3) competent cells.
Keep on ice 5 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, then ice 2 min.
Add 200 µL SOC medium, incubate 37 °C with shaking for 45 min.
Spread 100 µL culture on LB agar containing ampicillin, incubate 37 °C for 12–16 h.

steps.title: Transform His‑tagged Myo5a plasmids
steps.instruction: Introduce His‑Myo5a‑MTD or His‑Myo5a‑MTDΔG plasmids into BL21(DE3) cells and recover on kanamycin agar.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 ng (1 µL) plasmid (His‑Myo5a‑MTD/pET30a or His‑Myo5a‑MTDΔG/pET30a) into 100 µL BL21(DE3) competent cells.
Keep on ice 5 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 45 s, then ice 2 min.
Add 200 µL SOC medium, incubate 37 °C with shaking for 45 min.
Spread 100 µL culture on LB agar containing kanamycin, incubate 37 °C for 12–16 h.

steps.title: Culture GST‑Mlph‑ABD expression
steps.instruction: Grow transformed colonies and induce GST‑Mlph‑ABD protein expression.

substeps.instruction: Pick a single ampicillin‑resistant colony into 4 mL LB‑ampicillin medium (room temperature), shake 37 °C, 200 rpm, 6 h.
Inoculate 250 mL LB‑ampicillin with the 4 mL starter, shake 37 °C, 200 rpm, 3–4 h until OD₆₀₀ = 0.8–1.0.
Add 50 µL of 1 M IPTG (final 0.2 mM) and incubate either 37 °C, 200 rpm, 3 h **or** 17 °C, 200 rpm, 12 h.

steps.title: Culture His‑tagged Myo5a expression
steps.instruction: Grow transformed colonies and induce His‑Myo5a‑MTD or His‑Myo5a‑MTDΔG expression.

substeps.instruction: Pick a single kanamycin‑resistant colony into 4 mL LB‑kanamycin (room temperature), shake 37 °C, 200 rpm, 6 h.
Inoculate 250 mL LB‑kanamycin with the 4 mL starter, shake 37 °C, 200 rpm, 3–4 h until OD₆₀₀ = 0.8–1.0.
Add 50 µL of 1 M IPTG (final 0.2 mM) and incubate either 37 °C, 200 rpm, 3 h **or** 17 °C, 200 rpm, 12 h.

steps.title: Harvest and store GST‑Mlph‑ABD cells
steps.instruction: Collect induced GST‑Mlph‑ABD cells and keep pellets for purification.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture at 4 000 rpm (~3 000 × g) for 10 min at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 1× TBS, centrifuge again at 4 000 rpm for 10 min, discard supernatant.
Use pellets immediately or store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Harvest and store His‑Myo5a cells
steps.instruction: Collect induced His‑Myo5a cells and keep pellets for purification.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge culture at 4 000 rpm (~3 000 × g) for 10 min at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 1× TBS, centrifuge again at 4 000 rpm for 10 min, discard supernatant.
Use pellets immediately or store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Lyse GST‑Mlph‑ABD cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend GST‑Mlph‑ABD pellets, add nucleases and salts, and lyse by sonication.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet from 250 mL culture in 25 mL GST‑tag protein lysis buffer on ice for 20 min.
Add DNase I to 10 U/mL (final 10 U/mL), MgCl₂ to 3 mM (final), and NaCl to 0.2 M (final). Mix by inversion, incubate on ice 10 min.
Sonicate at 200 W with 3 s on/7 s off cycles, repeat 80 times.

steps.title: Lyse His‑Myo5a cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend His‑Myo5a pellets, add nucleases and salts, and lyse by sonication.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet from 250 mL culture in 25 mL His‑tag protein lysis buffer on ice for 20 min.
Add DNase I to 10 U/mL (final), MgCl₂ to 3 mM (final), and NaCl to 0.2 M (final). Mix by inversion, incubate on ice 10 min.
Sonicate at 200 W with 3 s on/7 s off cycles, repeat 80 times.

steps.title: Clarify lysates
steps.instruction: Remove cell debris from both GST and His lysates by ultracentrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge each lysate at 20 000 rpm (~40 000 × g) for 40 min at 4 °C.
Collect supernatant into a 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Bind GST‑Mlph‑ABD to GSH‑Sepharose
steps.instruction: Capture GST‑Mlph‑ABD on glutathione beads.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate 1 mL GSH‑Sepharose 4 Fast Flow beads in 10 mL 1× TBS, let settle, discard supernatant.
Add beads to lysate supernatant, rotate at 4 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Bind His‑Myo5a to Ni‑agarose
steps.instruction: Capture His‑Myo5a proteins on Ni‑NTA agarose.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate 1 mL Ni‑NTA agarose in 10 mL 1× TBS, let settle, discard supernatant.
Add beads to lysate supernatant, rotate at 4 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Wash GST‑bound beads
steps.instruction: Remove non‑specific proteins from GSH‑Sepharose.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tube at 2 000 rpm (~800 × g) for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in ~50 mL GST‑tag protein washing buffer, centrifuge again 2 000 rpm 10 min, discard supernatant.
Transfer beads to a disposable column, rinse with washing buffer, monitor eluate with Bradford (5 µL eluate + 45 µL Bradford). Continue rinsing until eluate no longer turns blue.

steps.title: Wash His‑bound beads
steps.instruction: Remove non‑specific proteins from Ni‑NTA agarose.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge tube at 2 000 rpm (~800 × g) for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant.
Resuspend beads in ~50 mL His‑tag protein washing buffer, centrifuge again 2 000 rpm 10 min, discard supernatant.
Transfer beads to a disposable column, rinse with washing buffer, monitor eluate with Bradford (5 µL eluate + 45 µL Bradford). Continue rinsing until eluate no longer turns blue.

steps.title: Elute GST‑Mlph‑ABD
steps.instruction: Recover GST‑Mlph‑ABD from GSH‑Sepharose by gravity flow.

substeps.instruction: Apply GST‑tag protein elution buffer to the column, collect fractions.
Detect protein in each fraction with Bradford (5 µL + 45 µL).
Combine fractions containing high‑concentration protein.

steps.title: Elute His‑Myo5a proteins
steps.instruction: Recover His‑Myo5a‑MTD or His‑Myo5a‑MTDΔG from Ni‑NTA by gravity flow.

substeps.instruction: Apply His‑tag protein elution buffer to the column, collect fractions.
Detect protein in each fraction with Bradford (5 µL + 45 µL).
Combine fractions containing high‑concentration protein.

steps.title: Dialyze GST‑Mlph‑ABD
steps.instruction: Remove free amines by dialysis before labeling.

substeps.instruction: Cut dialysis tubing to appropriate length, boil in deionized water 100 °C for 3 min.
Transfer pooled GST eluate into tubing, dialyze against 1 L GST‑tag protein dialysis buffer overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Dialyze His‑Myo5a proteins
steps.instruction: Desalt His‑Myo5a proteins before MST.

substeps.instruction: Cut dialysis tubing to appropriate length, boil in deionized water 100 °C for 3 min.
Transfer pooled His eluate into tubing, dialyze against 1 L His‑tag protein dialysis buffer overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Concentrate GST‑Mlph‑ABD
steps.instruction: Increase protein concentration and store aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Load dialyzed GST protein into ultrafiltration tubes, centrifuge at 4 000 rpm (~3 000 × g) at 4 °C until desired concentration is reached.
Aliquot 20–200 µL, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C.
Measure concentration with Nanodrop‑1000 and assess purity by SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Concentrate His‑Myo5a proteins
steps.instruction: Increase protein concentration and store aliquots.

substeps.instruction: Load dialyzed His protein into ultrafiltration tubes, centrifuge at 4 000 rpm (~3 000 × g) at 4 °C until desired concentration is reached.
Aliquot 20–200 µL, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, store at –80 °C.
Measure concentration with Nanodrop‑1000 and assess purity by SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Prepare ATTO‑488 NHS‑ester dye
steps.instruction: Make a 10 mM stock and dilute to 1 mM for labeling.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 0.196 mg ATTO‑488 NHS‑ester in 20 µL DMSO (10 mM).
Dilute 2 µL of this stock with 18 µL GST‑tag protein dialysis buffer to obtain 1 mM working solution.

steps.title: Label GST‑Mlph‑ABD with ATTO‑488
steps.instruction: Conjugate dye to GST‑Mlph‑ABD at a 3:1 molar ratio.

substeps.instruction: Dilute GST‑Mlph‑ABD stock to 90 µL of 40 µM in GST‑tag protein dialysis buffer.
Add 10.8 µL of 1 mM ATTO‑488 NHS‑ester (final dye:protein molar ratio 3:1). Mix well.
Incubate 1 h at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Purify labeled GST‑Mlph‑ABD
steps.instruction: Remove free dye using a gravity‑flow column equilibrated with MST buffer.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate gravity‑flow column B with 3 mL MST buffer, repeat three times.
Load up to 500 µL of labeling reaction onto the column; if <500 µL, bring volume to 500 µL with MST buffer after entry, discard flow‑through.
Add 2 mL MST buffer, collect 200–250 µL fractions.

steps.title: Measure labeling efficiency
steps.instruction: Determine protein and dye concentrations of purified fractions with Nanodrop‑1000.

substeps.instruction: Place 3 µL deionized water on Nanodrop probe, open Proteins & Labels module, select Alexa Fluor 488 excitation.
Add 3 µL GST‑tag protein dialysis buffer, click Blank.
Add 3 µL each effluent fraction, click Measure.
Save fractions with high protein concentration and dye/protein molar ratio < 1.5 for MST.

steps.title: MST pre‑test of labeled GST‑Mlph‑ABD
steps.instruction: Verify fluorescence intensity of the labeled protein before binding experiments.

substeps.instruction: Dilute ATTO‑488‑labeled GST‑Mlph‑ABD to 40 nM with MST buffer.
Mix 10 µL of 40 nM labeled protein with 10 µL His‑tag protein dialysis buffer in a PCR tube, pipette up/down.
Load the mixture into a Monolith capillary, place capillary in sample tray (avoid optical section).
Insert tray into Monolith NT.115, start Mo.Control, select Start New Session, choose green excitation filter, run Pretest mode.
Confirm fluorescence intensity is between 200 and 1 000 (optimal 400–800).

steps.title: Prepare MST serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Create a 16‑point dilution series of His‑Myo5a‑MTD for binding assay.

substeps.instruction: Label 16 clean PCR tubes 1–16.
Add 10 µL His‑Myo5a‑MTD dialysis buffer to tubes 2–16; add 20 µL of 40 µM His‑Myo5a‑MTD to tube 1.
Transfer 10 µL from tube 1 to tube 2, mix; then transfer 10 µL from tube 2 to tube 3, and continue sequentially to tube 16. Discard 10 µL from tube 16 after mixing.
Add 10 µL ATTO‑488‑labeled GST‑Mlph‑ABD to each tube, mix, centrifuge 5 min at 13 000 × g.
Load each tube’s content into a clean Monolith capillary, place capillaries in sample tray, insert tray into instrument.

steps.title: Run MST binding affinity measurement
steps.instruction: Measure interaction between His‑Myo5a‑MTD and ATTO‑488‑labeled GST‑Mlph‑ABD.

substeps.instruction: In Mo.Control, select Binding Affinity, open the Plan interface.
Enter reaction temperature, initial and final concentrations of target (GST‑Mlph‑ABD) and ligand (His‑Myo5a‑MTD), estimated Kd, capillary type, excitation power, and MST power.
Click Go to Instructions to follow the software‑generated dilution protocol (if needed).
Click Start Measurement; the system records MST traces and calculates the dissociation constant Kd.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol or parts of it has been used and validated in the following research article: • Pan et al. [9]. Identification of a third myosin-5a-melanophilin interaction that mediates the association of myosin-5a with melanosomes. eLife ( Figure 3A ). We monitored the interaction between His-Myo5a-MTD and GST-Mlph-ABD using MST and obtained the dissociation constant (Kd) of 562 ± 169 nM of Myo5a-MTD for binding to Mlph-ABD. Consistent with the GST pulldown assay, we found that deletion of the C-terminal half of exon-G (His-Myo5a-MTDΔG) greatly decreased MST signaling.
